traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Expansion meets imagination. Idealism and vision on a large scale. The trine makes this a natural strength: Imaginative ideas that turn out to have practical application. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Growth and imagination flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what growth and imagination have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Inspired vision; test it against logic before committing.
shadow: The ease lets excess and overreach and illusion and escapism go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.

readerCopy.summary: A dream can start feeling less like something you are escaping into and more like something you might genuinely be able to build your life around.
readerCopy.body: A dream can start feeling less like something you are escaping into and more like something you might genuinely be able to build your life around. When Jupiter trines Neptune, imagination and confidence support each other, making a creative idea, compassionate goal, or long-held hope feel possible enough to receive more of your attention. You do not need to know every step before taking yourself seriously. Give the vision some of the time, money, or effort you normally reserve for things you already consider practical and see what becomes possible when the dream is allowed to compete for a place in your actual life.

base: Expansion meets imagination. Idealism and vision on a large scale. The trine makes this a natural strength: Imaginative ideas that turn out to have practical application. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.
